name: CL.TE
description: Classic Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding desync. Front-end uses Content-Length, back-end uses Transfer-Encoding. Body: chunked terminator (0\r\n\r\n) + smuggled prefix HELLO.

name: CL.TE Timing (Detect)
description: Timing probe for CL.TE desync. Front-end reads Content-Length: 4 and forwards 1\r\nA\r\n. Back-end reads Transfer-Encoding: chunked, processes chunk '1' (body=A), then sees 'X' as an incomplete next chunk and HANGS waiting — response delay confirms CL.TE.

name: TE.CL Timing (Detect)
